text: Khan et al. limit their results to setups where the debaters can provide verified evidence to the judge, note that the models were RLHF-tuned and honest-leaning so that suitability for deceptive models is unclear, and leave generalisation to domains needing larger evidence sets or parametric knowledge open (Sec. 6). The Lean theorem is correctness-only for an abstract finite oracle protocol and carries no language, machine or resource content. Transfer to a target task is unestablished.
